title: Tech Lead | AI Platform & Agents
description:

Essa posição terá papel estratégico na evolução da arquitetura de IA da Sankhya, conectando modelos de linguagem, contexto de dados e automação de decisões para resolver problemas reais de negócio em escala.

Buscamos alguém que combine profundidade técnica em GenAI, visão arquitetural e liderança hands-on, atuando próximo ao time, produto e arquitetura para construir plataformas de inteligência que integrem IA ao core das soluções da empresa.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

● Liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de soluções baseadas em IA Generativa e arquiteturas de agentes aplicadas ao produto

● Definir padrões e arquitetura para sistemas inteligentes, pipelines de GenAI e workflows de agentes

● Apoiar o time na construção de RAGs, agentes autônomos e mecanismos de contexto (MCPs)

● Atuar hands-on em iniciativas técnicas estratégicas ou de maior complexidade

● Traduzir desafios de negócio em soluções baseadas em IA aplicada e automação inteligente

● Definir boas práticas de engenharia para integração de LLMs com sistemas corporativos

● Liderar experimentação e evolução de provas de conceito de IA aplicada ao produto

● Garantir qualidade técnica através de code review, testes e observabilidade de sistemas de IA

● Monitorar performance, qualidade e riscos de soluções baseadas em modelos de IA

● Mentorar e desenvolver o time técnico, apoiando evolução de carreira e maturidade de engenharia

● Atuar como ponte entre tecnologia, produto e arquitetura, apoiando decisões técnicas estratégicas


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

Experiência essencial

● Experiência sólida com IA Generativa aplicada a produto

● Experiência com arquiteturas de agentes e workflows de LLMs

● Vivência prática com RAG, embeddings e vector databases

● Experiência com frameworks de agentes como LangChain, LangGraph ou similares

● Experiência integrando LLMs via APIs ou plataformas de IA (ex.: AWS Bedrock)

● Experiência colocando sistemas de IA ou ML em produção

● Forte experiência com Python para backend

● Domínio de boas práticas de arquitetura de software e atuação como referência técnica

Experiência complementar

● Conhecimento em Machine Learning tradicional

● Experiência com engenharia de dados e pipelines de dados

● Experiência com arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos

● Vivência com governança de dados ou plataformas de dados em escala


LOCALIDADE

Uberlândia/MG – Presencial

São Paulo/SP – Híbrido (2x/semana no escritório)

Outras localidades – Remoto

title: Full-Time Social Ads Specialist
description:
About Us

BlueTuskr is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. As we continue to expand our paid advertising efforts across client accounts, we’re looking for a full-time Social Ads Specialist with strong technical (conversion tracking) and analytical skills, as well as proven client-facing experience. This role is 100% focused on paid social advertising — not SEO, not organic social.


What You’ll Do

As a Social Ads Specialist, you will manage a portfolio of social ad accounts for our clients, the majority of which are e-commerce sellers. You will be responsible for optimization, budgeting, monitoring, interpreting data and analytics, and clearly communicating campaign performance and strategy directly with clients. You will also stay current on new strategies, techniques, and processes that can improve campaign performance.


Platforms will primarily include Facebook and Instagram, with potential exposure to LinkedIn, Pinterest, and TikTok.


We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, analytical, demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can confidently own both campaign performance and client relationships. This includes leading client calls, presenting performance insights, and acting as a strategic partner.


This role requires a strong understanding of post-iOS14 conversion strategies, audience targeting (lookalikes, custom audiences, interests, etc.), placements, and campaign structure. You must also be able to maintain accurate conversion tracking, including pixel setup, event configuration, and event prioritization.


More specifically, in this role you will:

  • Execute and optimize paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts
  • Own client communication, including leading calls and presenting performance updates
  • Measure and report campaign performance against goals (ROI and KPIs)
  • Recommend, execute, and analyze testing strategies for clients
  • Strategize ways to improve overall campaign performance
  • Stay current on the latest paid ads trends and platform updates


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of proven experience managing paid social campaigns for e-commerce brands (especially Meta)
  • 2+ years of experience working within an agency environment (either in-house or servicing agency clients)
  • Proven client-facing experience, including leading calls and managing client relationships


What This Role Is NOT

This is not an SEO role, not organic social media management, and not content creation or community management. If your experience is not primarily in paid advertising, this role is not the right fit.


Time Commitment

Full-time. Remote. Ability to work during standard Eastern Time business hours is required.


Pay

$3,500–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience.


If you’re passionate about paid social advertising and know how to drive results for e-commerce brands, we look forward to hearing from you!

title: Sr. Backend Engineer (Node.js)
description:
About You

You are a senior-level Backend Engineer (Node.js) who thrives in challenging environments and enjoys taking ownership of complex systems to transform them into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions.


You are highly hands-on and comfortable working with evolving or partially structured codebases. You can quickly assess risks, identify critical issues, and execute remediation strategies under tight timelines. You value clean code, security best practices, and reliable system behavior.


You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical challenges clearly, and play a key role in stabilizing applications and restoring confidence in production systems. You are motivated by making a tangible impact and contributing to the successful relaunch and future scalability of a critical platform.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend development using Node.js.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong experience working with REST APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Proven experience handling legacy systems, codebase audits, or technical recovery scenarios.
  • Solid understanding of application security best practices, including secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS environments and services.
  • Experience setting up or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong experience working with PostgreSQL databases (RDS preferred).
  • Familiarity with proxies, CORS, and common web security vulnerabilities (e.g., SSRF).
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments with ambiguous or incomplete documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize issues based on business impact.
  • Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of the Node.js backend and perform a full technical assessment of the codebase.
  • Identify and remediate critical security vulnerabilities and insecure integrations.
  • Refactor unstable or low-quality code to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Stabilize core application flows required for production readiness.
  • Re-establish codebase ownership by organizing and migrating repositories within the client environment.
  • Analyze and restore CI/CD pipelines across repositories and environments.
  • Set up and validate staging environments to support testing and release processes.
  • Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms.
  • Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes.
  • Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability.
  • Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes.
  • Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development.
  • Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Node.js backend development.
  • Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects.
  • Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations.
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Dental Insurance Posting Agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.


As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you’ll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You’ll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.


About iCore


iCore is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.

We are more than a software company. iCoreConnect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.

Behind iCoreConnect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We’re proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.


Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.


Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.


Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.


Objectives:


  • Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
  • Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
  • Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
  • Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
  • Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
  • Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
  • Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
  • Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
  • Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns


Competencies:

  • Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
  • Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
  • High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
  • Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
  • Full English proficiency
  • Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
  • Ability to pass job-specific assessments


Benefits:


Personal:

  • Be a valued leader, not just a trainer

You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.


  • Make a real difference at scale

Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices , and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.


  • Work with a mission-driven team

You’ll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.


  • 100% remote – work from home

Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.


  • Better work-life balance

While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.


  • Stability and long-term growth

Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.


Professional:

  • Grow your training and leadership skills

Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.


  • Work with industry leaders in dental

Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.


  • Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology

Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.


  • Build and lead teams

Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.


  • Expand your industry network

Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.


  • Develop enterprise-level experience

Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.


What you can expect from a career with our team!

  • Competitive hourly rate
  • Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST
  • Commitment: Full-time, 40+ hours per week
  • Work Setup: Fully remote position


You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals.

If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!

title: Sr. Backend Engineer (Node.js)
description:
About You

You are a senior-level Backend Engineer (Node.js) who thrives in challenging environments and enjoys taking ownership of complex systems to transform them into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions.


You are highly hands-on and comfortable working with evolving or partially structured codebases. You can quickly assess risks, identify critical issues, and execute remediation strategies under tight timelines. You value clean code, security best practices, and reliable system behavior.


You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical challenges clearly, and play a key role in stabilizing applications and restoring confidence in production systems. You are motivated by making a tangible impact and contributing to the successful relaunch and future scalability of a critical platform.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend development using Node.js.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong experience working with REST APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Proven experience handling legacy systems, codebase audits, or technical recovery scenarios.
  • Solid understanding of application security best practices, including secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS environments and services.
  • Experience setting up or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong experience working with PostgreSQL databases (RDS preferred).
  • Familiarity with proxies, CORS, and common web security vulnerabilities (e.g., SSRF).
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments with ambiguous or incomplete documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize issues based on business impact.
  • Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of the Node.js backend and perform a full technical assessment of the codebase.
  • Identify and remediate critical security vulnerabilities and insecure integrations.
  • Refactor unstable or low-quality code to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Stabilize core application flows required for production readiness.
  • Re-establish codebase ownership by organizing and migrating repositories within the client environment.
  • Analyze and restore CI/CD pipelines across repositories and environments.
  • Set up and validate staging environments to support testing and release processes.
  • Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms.
  • Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes.
  • Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability.
  • Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes.
  • Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development.
  • Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Node.js backend development.
  • Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects.
  • Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations.
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.

Preferred Qualifications:

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.

This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.

We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.



Why this role exists

We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing DevOps operations and architecture support.

We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.

Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.



TL;DR

You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:

  • Lead cloud migrations to OCI
  • Design cloud architectures
  • Automate migrations and infrastructure
  • Coordinate DevOps engineers
  • Talk directly to clients
  • Help build repeatable DevOps processes

You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.

English is a plus, not required.



This is not a ticket-based DevOps job

If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.

This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:


\"We can automate 80% of this.\"

And then actually build the automation.



What you'll actually do

Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.



Cloud Migrations

A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.

Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.



Automation

We want to automate everything that can be automated:

  • Automated infrastructure provisioning
  • Migration scripts
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Environment replication
  • Monitoring setups

If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.



Client Discussions

You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.



Leading DevOps Engineers

As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.



What we're looking for

You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.

You likely:

  • Love automating infrastructure
  • Hate manual processes
  • Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
  • Are comfortable debugging production environments
  • Enjoy designing architectures
  • Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients

You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.



Technical Expectations

Cloud

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
  • AWS
  • Azure
  • GCP

    • DevOps

    • Docker
    • Kubernetes
    • Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
    • CI/CD pipelines
    • Linux systems administration
    • Networking fundamentals

    Automation

    Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.


    Languages

    Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.


    Why work with Quave

    We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.

    Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.

    Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).


    Pay and Benefits

    This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.

    • Fully remote work
    • Flexible hours
    • 22 days paid time off per year
    • Quarterly bonus based on company performance
    • AI allowance for productivity tools

    We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.


    Hiring Process

    • Application review
    • Technical conversation
    • Architecture discussion
    • Conversation(s) with one or more partners
    • This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the DevOps work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

Um programa intensivo de capacitação voltado à formação de consultores SAP.

title: Product Owner - Sênior
description:
Product Owner - Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

No seu dia a dia, você gerenciará o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuará como principal interlocutor entre as áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório, supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Você liderará cerimônias ágeis e garantirá a entrega contínua de valor, promovendo melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás. Além disso, acompanhará métricas de desempenho do produto (KPIs de negócio e de uso), proporá evoluções baseadas em dados e feedback dos usuários, e garantirá que as soluções desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulação do setor de gás.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias.
  • Atuar como principal interlocutor(a) entre áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório e supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis.
  • Liderar cerimônias ágeis e garantir a entrega contínua de valor para o produto.
  • Promover melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás.
  • Acompanhar métricas de desempenho (KPIs de negócio e de uso), analisando dados para direcionar evoluções do produto.
  • Propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks dos usuários.
  • Garantir que as soluções estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança e regulação do setor.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Perfil de liderança com forte viés de execução, sendo “mão na massa”, orientado(a) a resultados e capaz de remover impedimentos para garantir entregas com qualidade e agilidade.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de transitar entre áreas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia.
  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de produto (roadmaps, OKRs, MVPs).
  • Experiência na liderança de squads multidisciplinares e atuação em ciclos de discovery e delivery.
  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver certificações em Product Ownership (CSPO, PSPO) e metodologias ágeis (CSM, SAFe).
  • Tiver familiaridade com o setor de gás e energia, incluindo regulação da ANP e processos como medição, faturamento, logística e segurança operacional.
  • Demonstrar forte visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico.

  • Ser resiliente e adaptável em ambientes de alta complexidade.
  • Ter perfil colaborativo e facilitador.
  • Demonstrar orientação a resultados e senso de urgência.
  • Possuir experiência em contextos dinâmicos.

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

Strategic Planning: Regional Marketing Managers must be adept at developing and executing marketing strategies that align with overall business objectives. This includes setting clear goals, defining KPIs, and creating actionable plans.

Team Leadership and Management: Effective leadership skills are important for managing and motivating a team of marketing professionals. This includes providing guidance, setting expectations, and facilitating collaboration.

Campaign Management: This skill involves planning, executing, and optimizing marketing campaigns. It requires the ability to set clear objectives, target the right audience, and measure the effectiveness of campaigns.

Budget Management: Effective allocation and management of marketing budgets are essential for maximizing return on investment (ROI) and ensuring that resources are used efficiently.

Data Analysis and Interpretation: Proficiency in using data analytics tools to measure campaign performance, track key metrics, and derive actionable insights is crucial for making informed marketing decisions.

Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills are necessary for conveying marketing messages effectively to various stakeholders, including team members, executives, and external partners.

Adaptability and Flexibility: The ability to adapt to changing market conditions, consumer preferences, and industry trends is vital for staying competitive and achieving long-term success.

Problem-Solving Skills: Regional Marketing Managers should be able to identify challenges and develop creative solutions to overcome them. This includes being resourceful and thinking critically.

Cultural Awareness and Sensitivity: Especially in a regional role, understanding and respecting cultural nuances and preferences is important for tailoring marketing strategies to specific markets.

Time Management: Effectively prioritizing tasks and managing time to meet deadlines is essential in a fast-paced marketing environment.

Tech-Savviness: Familiarity with marketing technology tools and platforms, as well as proficiency in relevant software and applications, is important for executing marketing initiatives efficiently.

Negotiation Skills: The ability to negotiate and build partnerships with external stakeholders, such as agencies, vendors, and media outlets, can be crucial for successful marketing campaigns.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
This is mostly manual position. This role is fully remote and is a PJ contractor.


Required Skills & Experience


• 7+ years of experience in Quality Assurance (manual and/or blended QA roles) with strong ownership of test execution and release readiness.

• Jira proficiency for defect tracking, workflows, and reporting.

• Hands-on experience with API testing (e.g., Postman, Swagger, curl, or similar) — note: API work is a smaller portion (~10%).

• Cruise / travel / hotel / hospitality industry experience

• Strong understanding of QA fundamentals: test design, defect lifecycle, SDLC/STLC, and Agile testing practices. Excellent communication skills and ability to partner cross-functionally.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Experience testing eCommerce, booking engines, reservations, loyalty, payments, check-in/boarding, or guest service platforms.

• Exposure to test automation (any framework/tool) and ability to collaborate with automation engineers (if applicable).

• Basic SQL for validation, data checks, or troubleshooting. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and release processes.


Job Description


We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of customer-facing and internal applications in a fast-paced travel/hospitality environment. This role will partner closely with product, engineering, and delivery teams to define test strategy, execute testing across releases, and continuously improve QA processes. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on QA experience, deep familiarity with Jira, and working knowledge of API testing (a smaller portion of the overall workload).


Day to Day

• Own and execute end-to-end testing for web and/or mobile applications, including functional, regression, smoke, and UAT support.

• Create and maintain clear test plans, test cases, and test execution evidence aligned to release timelines.

• Work in Agile/Scrum teams to provide early QA input on requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases.

• Log, track, and manage defects in Jira, ensuring high-quality documentation and strong follow-through through resolution.

• Perform API validation/testing (estimated ~10% of overall effort) using tools such as Postman/Swagger or similar; validate request/response payloads and integration behaviors.

• Collaborate with engineers and product owners to reproduce issues, validate fixes, and confirm release readiness.

• Help improve QA efficiency through better test coverage, risk-based testing, and repeatable regression approaches. Contribute to quality standards, best practices, and continuous improvement across the SDLC.

title: Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
  • Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
  • Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
  • Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
  • Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
  • Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
  • Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
  • Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
  • Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
  • Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
  • Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
  • Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
  • Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
  • Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
  • Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
  • Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
  • Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento).
  • Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança).
  • Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados).

title: Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases
description:
Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases


Location: Ukraine, Armenia, Moldova, Brazil(Remote)


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Data Engineer to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


About the Role


We're hiring a Senior DBA to own the database layer across our production systems — OLTP relational databases as the operational store and an OLAP columnar database for analytics. Data flows between them via a CDC pipeline (Debezium → Kafka) managed by our infrastructure team. You'll own what's on both ends: schema design, data modeling, query performance, and analytics enablement.

This is a high-ownership role. You'll be the technical authority on how our data is structured, how it performs, and how schema changes propagate safely from OLTP to OLAP stores. You'll work closely with application teams, data consumers, and the infrastructure team that operates the CDC pipeline.


What You'll Own

  • OLTP schema design: Data modeling, indexing strategies, migration planning, and performance tuning across multiple database clusters
  • OLAP data modeling: Table design, materialized views, partitioning, and query optimization for analytics workloads
  • Schema evolution: Coordinating schema changes with the infrastructure team to ensure safe propagation through the CDC pipeline
  • Query performance: Profiling, optimization, and capacity planning across both OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Data integrity: Validation, reconciliation, and monitoring to ensure consistency between OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Technical leadership: Standards for schema management, review processes, mentoring, and cross-team collaboration


Tech Stack

  • OLTP: Aurora MySQL 8.0 (multiple clusters, multi-AZ)
  • OLAP: ClickHouse 25.x
  • CDC Pipeline: Debezium 3.3.2 → Kafka 4.0 → ClickHouse
  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
  • Cloud: AWS (EKS, RDS, S3)


Requirements

  • 5+ years as a DBA or data engineer, 2+ in a senior/lead role
  • Strong experience with OLTP relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or similar) — schema design, indexing, query optimization, replication, migrations
  • Strong experience with OLAP/columnar databases (ClickHouse, Vertica, Greenplum, Druid, Doris, or similar) — table design, materialized views, partitioning, query optimization Deep SQL expertise across both transactional and analytical query patterns
  • Experience with schema migration strategies in environments with downstream consumers (CDC, ETL, replication)
  • Familiarity with data consistency challenges between OLTP and OLAP systems



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Debezium or CDC systems — understanding how schema changes affect downstream pipelines
  • Healthcare data or regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC2)
  • Data quality frameworks — validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection
  • dbt, Airflow, or similar transformation/orchestration tools
  • Performance benchmarking and capacity planning for OLAP databases
  • Experience with AWS RDS/Aurora operational features — Parameter Groups, Performance Insights.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Especialista em Branding
description:

Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?

Por isso, buscamos um Super Especialista em Branding , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Marketing e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.

Requisitos


  • Ensino superior completo em Publicidade e Propaganda, Jornalismo, Marketing ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência na gestão e aplicação de Brand Systems (brandbook, diretrizes visuais e tom de voz);
  • Conhecimento em pesquisas de marca, análise de mercado e concorrência;
  • Experiência em projetos de branding ou rebranding;
  • Capacidade de definir, planejar e executar estratégias de marca;
  • Habilidade para identificar tendências de mercado e comportamento do consumidor;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de storytelling e excelente habilidade de escrita;
  • Capacidade de transitar entre diferentes contextos, projetos e stakeholders;
  • Olhar crítico para identidade visual e revisão de peças (texto e design);
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos e iniciativas de marca simultaneamente.



Diferenciais


  • Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos, como startups ou empresas em processo de expansão;
  • Experiência com produção de eventos corporativos;
  • Experiência com assessoria de imprensa.



O que você pode esperar dos Supers?


  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.

title: Oracle EBS O2C Functional Consultant
description:
Job Title: Oracle EBS O2C Functional Consultant

Location: Brazil Remote

Duration: Nearshore / Contract


Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced Oracle EBS O2C (Order to Cash) Functional Consultant with strong expertise in Oracle E-Business Suite Financials and Order Management modules. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in end-to-end O2C cycle implementation and support, with added knowledge of Brazil tax regulations and localization requirements.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement, configure, and support Oracle EBS O2C modules including Order Management (OM), Accounts Receivable (AR), Advanced Pricing, and Inventory.
  • Manage end-to-end O2C cycle: Order Entry → Shipping → Invoicing → Receivables → Collections → Cash Application.
  • Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into functional specifications.
  • Work closely with technical teams for RICEFW objects (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Extensions, Forms, Workflows).
  • Support month-end and year-end financial closing activities related to AR and revenue recognition.
  • Provide production support and resolve functional issues.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Finance, Supply Chain, and Tax.


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience as an Oracle EBS Functional Consultant.
  • Strong hands-on experience in O2C modules (OM, AR, Pricing, Shipping, Inventory) .
  • Experience in at least one full lifecycle implementation.
  • Good understanding of accounting principles and AR processes.
  • Experience in writing functional design documents (FDDs).
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Brazil tax localization , including knowledge of Brazil tax laws (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS).
  • Familiarity with Brazil fiscal reporting, Nota Fiscal (NF-e), and local statutory compliance requirements.
  • Experience working with global or LATAM implementations.

title: Category Manager
description:
We are hiring an analytically elite Category Manager / Category Analyst to serve as the commercial intelligence engine for a fast-growing CPG brand scaling from. This role blends deep category analytics, trade optimization, and retail strategy with storytelling that drives better decisions — internally and with key partners.


You will transform complex datasets — syndicated data (SPINS, Nielsen, IRI), retailer portals (e.g., 84.51°), distributor reporting, and internal systems — into actionable insights that meaningfully improve velocity, trade efficiency, pricing, and distribution performance. This person is the strategic partner to Sales, Marketing, Ops, Finance, and Leadership.


Strategic Importance


  • As we scale nationally and deepen relationships with major retailers and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), this role is critical to commercial success by:
  • Elevating category insights as a competitive advantage
  • Strengthening sales pitches with data-backed stories that win distribution
  • Increasing promo ROI through rigorous trade and lift analysis
  • Driving cross-functional alignment on strategy via clear analytics + narratives
  • This role is not just about dashboards — it’s about impact and influence across the business.



Key Responsibilities


  • Syndicated Data + Retailer Insights
  • Own analysis of SPINS, Nielsen/IRI and retailer portal data to understand:
  • Category growth drivers
  • Competitor dynamics
  • Velocity and share trends
  • Translate data into retailer-specific insights for buyers and commercial teams.


Promotion & Trade Effectiveness


  • Measure incremental lift, promo effectiveness, and trade ROI.
  • Partner with Sales and Finance to improve TPM discipline, promotional forecasting and post mortems.
  • Create frameworks to compare promo results vs. baseline and forecast.


Assortment, Pricing, and Space Strategy


  • Recommend SKU rationalization, pricing strategies, and assortment optimization.
  • Partner with Sales/Category buyers on planogram space recommendations.


Distributor & Retail Performance Tracking

Track performance across key channels and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), including:


  • Fill rates
  • Retail sell-through
  • Inventory health and void risk


Provide early-warning signals and corrective action recommendations.

Forecasting & Demand Planning Support


  • Improve forecast accuracy and alignment with Supply Chain and Finance.
  • Provide insights that enhance S&OP and promotional planning.


Cross-Functional Analytics & Reporting

Build and maintain executive-ready dashboards in Power BI / Tableau.


Provide cadence reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly) tailored to:


  • Sales
  • Marketing
  • Finance
  • Operations


Executive Storytelling & Data Communication


  • Translate analytics into structured business narratives that inform strategy and execution.
  • Support pitch materials, competitive heatmaps, and retailer presentations.


Required Experience & Skills


Experience


  • 3–8+ years in CPG analytics, category management, revenue management, or related retail strategy roles.


Proven track record with:


  • Syndicated data platforms (SPINS, Nielsen/IRI)
  • Retailer portals (84.51°, Luminate)
  • Commercial analytics in a growth CPG environment


Technical Skills


  • Advanced Excel (modeling, pivot tables, data transformations)
  • Power BI / Tableau dashboard creation
  • Familiarity with trade spend economics, TPM, and promotional lift frameworks


Capabilities


  • Strong analytical rigor and ability to build structured insights
  • Excellent communication and executive presence
  • Storytelling that transforms data into selling narratives


Preferred Experience


  • Experience in frozen or high-velocity CPG categories
  • Prior work with national retailers and major distributors
  • Startup or high-growth CPG environment

title: Marketing Specialist
description:

We’re a fast-paced, growing startup led by former Uber and Amazon team members, and we’re looking for someone excited to move quickly and contribute ideas that make a real impact.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and results-driven Marketing Specialist to join our team. This role combines strong execution skills with analytical thinking and excellent project management.


This role supports the planning and execution of marketing initiatives across multiple channels including email, SMS, social media, and website content. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with data, and able to manage multiple marketing projects simultaneously.


You will work closely with other company departments to execute campaigns, analyze performance, and continuously improve how customers discover and engage with our products.

  • Support lifecycle marketing initiatives including newsletters, SMS campaigns, product launches, and promotional moments.
  • Collaborate with the team to identify marketing opportunities and propose ideas that improve campaign performance.



Content & Brand Communication

  • Write clear, engaging copy for newsletters, SMS campaigns, social media, blog posts, and other marketing materials.
  • Maintain a consistent brand voice across all marketing channels.
  • Coordinate content calendars aligned with seasonal themes, product launches, and marketing priorities.
  • Monitor social media conversations and user-generated content to identify engagement opportunities.


Digital Marketing & Analytics

  • Track and analyze campaign performance across email, SMS, social media, and website channels.
  • Interpret marketing data and provide actionable insights to improve campaign performance.
  • Assist with SEO initiatives including keyword research, content optimization, and website improvements.
  • Support customer surveys and feedback analysis to help inform product and marketing decisions.


Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Manage multiple marketing projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Work with designers, photographers, videographers, and other cross-functional partners to prepare creative briefs and campaign assets.
  • Ensure marketing initiatives are delivered on time and aligned with campaign goals.
  • Maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail across all marketing initiatives.


Requirements

  • Fluent in English (C1 level or higher). Exceptional written and spoken communication is essential.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.

  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Experience working with email and SMS marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, Attentive, or similar tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to suggest ideas and take initiative.
  • Strong copywriting skills with a knack for storytelling and brand voice.
  • Experience managing social media accounts and understanding platform best practices.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing principles, including email marketing and social content strategy.
  • Knowledge of SEO is a plus.


How to Apply

Candidates must submit their resumes in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
  • Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
  • Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
  • Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
  • Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
  • Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
  • Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
  • Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
  • Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.

title: Analista de CRM Pleno

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Application Security Engineer with 5+ years of experience to help strengthen the security posture of the software platforms. This role will be responsible for reviewing application code, identifying security vulnerabilities, and working closely with development teams to ensure secure coding practices are followed throughout the software development lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will have strong experience in application penetration testing, fraud detection and analysis, and secure software development practices. This individual will play a key role in proactively identifying risks in PHP, Python, and Angular applications, while also educating development teams on secure coding standards and best practices.


Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class property management system integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct regular security assessments, code reviews, and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in applications and software, including manual and automated code reviews for applications written in PHP, Python, and Angular
  • Analyze applications for common vulnerabilities such as those identified in the OWASP Top 10, including risks related to authentication, authorization, data validation, and session management
  • Conduct application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments on web applications and APIs, simulating real-world attack scenarios to uncover security weaknesses and documenting findings with recommended mitigation strategies
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments to proactively identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies
  • Track, analyze, and manage vulnerabilities in applications while providing guidance and support for remediation efforts
  • Analyze application behavior and transaction patterns to detect potential fraud or abuse scenarios and identify vulnerabilities that could enable account takeover, payment fraud, or data manipulation
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to design controls that reduce fraud risk.
  • Work closely with development teams to ensure security best practices are integrated throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including developing secure coding guidelines, delivering secure coding training, and providing guidance during design and architecture reviews
  • Design, develop, and implement security tools, frameworks, and methodologies to protect applications against security threats, including integrating and maintaining security testing tools such as SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning within CI/CD pipelines
  • Assist in investigating, analyzing, and responding to security incidents related to applications, ensuring timely resolution and documentation of incidents
  • Track vulnerabilities and remediation progress through internal ticketing systems while collaborating with engineering, DevOps, and product teams to improve the overall application security posture and assist in developing internal security policies and procedures


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing, or secure software development
  • Strong understanding of web application security principles and the OWASP Top 10
  • Experience reviewing code in PHP, Python, and modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular
  • Experience performing application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments
  • Knowledge of authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure session management
  • Experience identifying and mitigating fraud or abuse patterns in applications
  • Familiarity with common security testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, SonarQube, etc.)
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security issues to non-security engineers


Desired Experience:

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with cloud security principles
  • Experience with secure architecture reviews
  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, CEH, GWAPT, or CSSLP
  • Experience working in agile development environments


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Integration Analyst
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar como Integration Analyst , apoiando iniciativas estratégicas de integração de sistemas e desenvolvimento em nuvem.
  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir soluções utilizando .NET (C#) , aplicando boas práticas de arquitetura, SOLID e Design Patterns .
  • Criar, consumir e manter APIs REST , garantindo segurança, escalabilidade e performance.
  • Implementar e sustentar soluções em Azure , utilizando serviços como Azure Functions, App Services, Storage, Service Bus, Key Vault e Application Insights .
  • Trabalhar com integração de sistemas entre múltiplas plataformas , incluindo ambientes corporativos e parceiros externos.
  • Atuar com CI/CD , versionamento e automação utilizando GitHub e GitHub Actions .
  • Implementar e manter testes automatizados (unitários e de integração).
  • Garantir segurança de APIs , utilizando padrões como OAuth2 e JWT .
  • Produzir e manter documentação técnica clara e estruturada .
  • Colaborar com times técnicos internos, stakeholders de negócio e parceiros externos em um ambiente corporativo global.
  • Atuar em times Agile , participando de cerimônias Scrum e/ou SAFe.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos com desenvolvimento .NET (C#) .
  • Vivência prática com metodologias ágeis (Scrum e/ou SAFe).
  • Experiência comprovada com Azure Cloud , incluindo:
  • Azure Functions
  • Azure App Services
  • Azure Storage
  • Azure Key Vault
  • Azure Service Bus
  • Application Insights
  • Certificação AZ-104 – Azure Administrator .
  • Experiência com controle de versão (Git/GitHub) e pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions).
  • Experiência em integração de sistemas e desenvolvimento de APIs REST .
  • Conhecimento em segurança de APIs (OAuth2, JWT).
  • Vivência com testes automatizados (unit e integration tests).
  • Aplicação consistente de Clean Code , Design Patterns e princípios SOLID.
  • Inglês avançado (escrita e conversação).


Será um destaque no seu perfil

  • Experiência com Salesforce , incluindo:
  • Lightning Web Components (LWC)
  • Apex Classes e Triggers
  • Flows
  • Experience Cloud (Builder)
  • Integração com APIs externas
  • Salesforce Commerce Cloud
  • Flosum
  • Conhecimento de objetos padrão e customizados no Salesforce.
  • Certificação AZ-204 – Developing Solutions for Microsoft Azure .
  • Experiência com publicação de aplicativos mobile (Apple Store e Google Play).
  • Familiaridade com Google Firebase .
  • Experiência prévia em ambientes corporativos multinacionais .
  • Certificações adicionais em integração ou tecnologias de desenvolvimento.


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa. A posição é oferecida em regime 100% Home Office , com atuação para um time global e ambiente ágil.

title: Senior Network Security Engineer
description:
The Network Security Engineer is responsible for protecting an organization’s networks and data from cyber threats. This role involves designing, implementing, and maintaining security infrastructure (firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, VPNs, etc.) and monitoring the network for vulnerabilities or incidents. The engineer will play a critical role in upholding Zero Trust security principles and ensuring high availability and integrity of network services in a dynamic, cloud-enabled environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Security Infrastructure Management: Configure, deploy, and maintain network security systems (firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN gateways, encryption devices) to safeguard internal networks and cloud environments.
  • Threat Monitoring & Incident Response: Monitor network traffic and logs for suspicious activities; promptly investigate and respond to security incidents or breaches to minimize impact.
  • Vulnerability Assessment: Conduct regular security audits, vulnerability scans, and penetration tests to identify and remediate network weaknesses. Implement patches and updates to address vulnerabilities and ensure systems are protected against emerging threats.
  • Access Control & Policies: Enforce access controls and network segmentation (supporting a Zero Trust Network Access model) by administering firewalls and network access control lists. Develop and update network security policies, standards, and procedures to align with best practices and compliance requirements.
  • Collaboration & Advisory: Work closely with IT infrastructure teams, application developers, and security architects to integrate security measures into new projects and systems. Provide guidance on secure network design and educate team members on security best practices.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain detailed documentation of configurations, incidents, and changes. Ensure all network security measures comply with relevant regulations and industry standards (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS) and assist in preparing for security audits.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • Technical Skills: Strong understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, etc.) and hands-on experience with network security technologies (firewalls such as Palo Alto/Cisco/Fortinet, IDS/IPS, VPN solutions, SIEM tools). Proficiency in configuring and managing firewalls and routing/switching equipment in complex networks.
  • Security Expertise: Knowledge of cybersecurity principles , threat landscape, and best practices (e.g., Zero Trust architecture, defense-in-depth, encryption, secure network design ). Ability to perform log analysis, intrusion detection, malware analysis basics, and incident handling.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for diagnosing network and security issues. Ability to respond effectively under pressure during security incidents or outages.
  • Communication & Teamwork: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders, and provide user training or guidance on security policies when needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced/Cloud Security: Experience with cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP networking and security services) or secure network design in hybrid cloud environments . Familiarity with SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) frameworks or software-defined networking is a plus.
  • Automation & Scripting: Scripting or automation skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to automate network/security tasks and improve efficiency in security operations.
  • Advanced Education: Master’s degree in Cybersecurity or Information Systems.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in network security, cybersecurity engineering, or a related IT infrastructure security role. Proven track record implementing and managing firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, and performing security monitoring and incident response in an enterprise or managed services environment.

Certifications:

  • Industry Certifications: Professional certifications are highly advantageous . Preferred certifications include CISSP, CISM (for security management knowledge) or CEH, GIAC (for technical security skills). Vendor-specific certifications such as Palo Alto Networks PCNSE/PCNSA are also valuable and demonstrate expertise in relevant technologies.

title: Business Development Manager/Director
description:
PingPong is on a mission to digitize trade, simplifying global growth for businesses. With $300B+ in payments processed, we're one of the world’s leading cross-border platforms – and we’re just getting started.

PingPong currently has 38 offices in 15 countries and over 1,500 employees. Our international presence helps businesses solve complex payment needs in every major economy across all time zones.


Now, we're scaling and looking for a BD Manager/Director to own the strategy, pipeline, and partnerships that will power our next phase of growth.


WHAT’S THE CHALLENGE?


You will take ownership for growing our customers and revenue in the region. You’ll land high-impact deals with banks, fintechs, platforms and enterprises. You’ve got the commercial sharpness to close complex deals.


WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH


You’ll partner closely with our local Compliance, Product, Marketing and operations teams to build a cohesive user journey that delivers the right product to the right users, at the right time. You’ll also collaborate with colleagues across US, EU and other regions and with Group HQ teams.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING


  • Build and execute our BD strategy across the LATAM with a focus on financial institutions, platforms and enterprise clients.
  • Maintain a high-quality pipeline across identified target verticals, focusing on high-impact deals, and think through supporting business development strategies.
  • Own the full sales cycle for closing new partners – from sourcing and qualification to leading the definition of the solution for the partner and negotiating the commercials, all the way through to go-live.
  • Pitch our API-first platform, solving real cross-border pain points.
  • Lead commercial and legal negotiations with C-level execs.
  • Work to improve our go-to-market approach, refining messaging, pricing strategy, and pitch materials based on feedback from partners and insights about competitors.
  • Collaborate internally, sharing feedback and insights from the LATAM market to product teams and senior management to inform roadmap and investment decisions.
  • Continuously refine our go-to-market playbook based on what works.
  • Be the voice of the UK market internally – and help drive what comes next.


WHAT YOU BRING


  • Track record in BD, partnerships, or enterprise sales in fintech or financial services:
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in closing complex, high-value deals with financial institutions or regulated entities
  • Fluency in the world of payments, FX, embedded finance, or APIs.
  • Strategic thinker, hands-on doer, data-driven operator.
  • Able to speak the language of product, compliance, and commercial teams.


WHO YOU ARE


  • Educated with a relevant degree in Business, Finance, or a related field. A master's degree is a plus.
  • Customer-focused, you can’t imagine working in any other way, and it’s the only way to achieve our goals.
  • Equally at home in both strategic planning and hands-on execution, ideally with experience in start-up/scale-up as well as larger organisations.
  • Ability to drill down, persistent and never-give-up spirit.
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop and execute high-impact business development strategies.
  • Strong consultative sales approach and experience negotiating with enterprise C-level executives.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills – able to influence internal and external stakeholders


PingPong is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer with a global culture that embraces diversity.

  • We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment.

title: Quality Assurance Tester
description:
Position: QA Lead / Test Engineer ( Remote)


Location: Rio Di Janeiro, Brazil


Duration - Full time


Salary - Competitive


Job Description

Do you have a strong background in quality assurance, a structured approach to testing, and want to join one of the largest technology companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting . Tieto Tech Consulting works as a true partner, solving clients’ toughest technology challenges and delivering reliable outcomes that drive measurable results. By combining engineering excellence with disciplined quality practices, we support customers developing and operating critical digital platforms.

In this role, you will work in close collaboration with product, engineering, and design teams, ensuring high quality, reliability, and scalability of backend services in a modern cloud-based environment.

When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a Quality Assurance Engineer, you will

  • Partner with product, engineering, and design teams to refine user stories, ensuring acceptance criteria are clear, complete, and testable.
  • Conduct daily evaluations of the QA swimlane in JIRA for new feature work and collaborate with engineers to execute test cycles.
  • Design, develop, and document comprehensive test plans and test cases for new and existing backend services.
  • Develop and maintain Postman API tests and automated integration test suites targeting backend services and data flows across AWS components (SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EventBridge).
  • Implement and manage API contract testing to validate integrations and ensure data consistency across internal and external services.
  • Design, execute, and maintain performance, load, and stress tests for critical backend infrastructure to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to define and test security, access control, and compliance requirements (e.g. HIPAA) for backend services handling sensitive data.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to establish continuous quality gates and support safe, frequent deployments.
  • Manage initial release completion, acting as the first quality gate by approving tickets when testing passes or returning them for rework when defects are identified.
  • Collaborate with QA Engineers across squads to ensure a consistent and high-quality experience for both patient- and provider-facing features.


Who we are looking for

  • Experienced QA professional with 5+ years of experience in startup or fast-paced environments, combining strong manual testing skills with automated testing capabilities.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience testing AWS-based backend architectures using Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, and EventBridge .
  • Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or TypeScript for writing and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end-to-end, and component tests .
  • Experience with performance, load, and stress testing applied to backend infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with API contract testing frameworks .
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
  • Familiarity with agile development practices and bug tracking tools (e.g. JIRA, BrowserStack ).
  • Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
  • Detail-oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.


We offer

We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture, and a strong work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to work in a growing and future-oriented sector, contributing to high-impact digital solutions. We provide a hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working, and we believe in curiosity and continuous learning as technology evolves.

Principais Responsabilidades:


Governança e Compliance

  • Desenvolver, revisar e manter políticas, normas e procedimentos de Segurança da Informação.

Gestão de Riscos e Controles
