title: Gerente de Obras Civis (Experiência em Projetos Industriais)
description:
Estamos em busca de um/a Gerente de Obras Civis, que será responsável pela execução civil de projetos petroquímicos, controlando interfaces, assegurando conformidade técnica, integridade estrutural, execução sequenciada e aderência a requisitos de segurança de processo. Este/a profissional atuará em uma de nossas obras na região do Rio de Janeiro/RJ, tendo estas atribuições principais:

  • Alinhar bases civis, estruturas, pipe-racks, utilidades e áreas de processo conforme sequenciamento eletromecânico e de instrumentação do projeto;
  • Conduzir reuniões técnicas multidisciplinares (Civil, Mecânica, Tubulação, E&I, Automação, SMS) para garantir a compatibilização de projetos e a antecipação de interferências críticas durante a execução das obras;
  • Validar soluções de projeto civil com foco nas necessidades específicas da planta, como cargas dinâmicas de equipamentos rotativos, vibração, fundações especiais para tanques e suportação de tubulações;
  • Controlar interfaces com montagens industriais, garantindo que as estruturas civis, bases e alinhamentos estejam liberados dentro do prazo para instalação de equipamentos críticos;
  • Gerenciar o desenvolvimento e atualização do ''As Built" civil sincronizado com alterações de campo, revisões de engenharia e modificações industriais (MOCs);
  • Acompanhar e validar ensaios e controles tecnológicos essenciais para áreas industriais, como ensaio de compactação, ensaios de integridade estrutural, controle de concretagem para bases de equipamentos e pavimentos industriais;
  • Integrar a obra civil aos requisitos de segurança de processo, garantindo atendimento a normas, zoneamentos, distanciamentos, contenções, bacias e drenagem industrial;
  • Gerenciar a interface com fornecedores e contratados, alinhando soluções técnicas e cronogramas para minimizar impactos entre civil, montagem eletromecânica e comissionamento;
  • Atuar em parceria com a área de Suprimentos, dimensionando corretamente a compra de materiais, prezando por custo e boa gestão de estoques;
  • Manter relacionamento produtivo e transparente com entidades sindicais e órgãos fiscalizadores, conhecendo a legislação trabalhista e convenção coletiva, preservando a segurança empresarial.

Perfil Requerido:

  • Formação Superior completa em Engenharia Civil;
  • Pós-Graduação e/ou MBA em Gerenciamento de Projetos, Gestão da Construção Civil, Segurança de Processos Industriais ou Gestão de Riscos;
  • Sólida experiência em obras do ramo industrial (plantas químicas, petroquímicas, siderúrgicas ou de processamento de gás, refinarias, termelétricas ou demais correlatas);
  • Amplo conhecimento das modalidades de contratos e subcontratos e suas implicações no andamento do projeto;
  • Conhecimentos acerca de metodologias 3D voltadas à modelagem e integração multidisciplinar (Civil, Mecânica, Tubulação, E&I);
  • Conhecimentos acerca dos principais softwares do Pacote Office, sobretudo Excel;
  • Disponibilidade / mobilidade para atuar em regime 100% presencial na região do Rio de Janeiro/RJ.

Sobre a Odebrecht:

A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é uma empresa que presta serviços nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais, sediada no Brasil e atende além deste país, outros quatro mercados: Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. Composta por mais de 20 mil Integrantes, a Odebrecht gera oportunidades de trabalho para as populações locais e contribui para o desenvolvimento sustentável de cada região, atuando nas seguintes áreas:

Transporte e Logística

Energia

Saneamento

Engenharia Industrial

Desenvolvimento Urbano e Edificações

Nossa Cultura:

A Nossa Cultura é um conjunto de princípios, conceitos e critérios, com foco na educação e no trabalho, que provê os fundamentos éticos, morais e conceituais para a atuação dos integrantes do Grupo. Valorizamos potencialidades do ser humano, como a disposição para servir, a capacidade e o desejo de evoluir e a vontade de superar resultados. Acreditamos, com convicção e determinação, que a prática da Cultura Odebrecht e das nossas políticas, com atuação ética, íntegra e transparente e o compromisso em promover a diversidade, nos fortalecem e aumentam a nossa competitividade, no rumo da sobrevivência, do crescimento e da perpetuidade.

title: Inspetor de Manutenção Aeronáutica
description:
A CHC do Brasil busca por pessoas Inspetor de Manutenção Aeronáutica.

O profissional será responsável por garantir a segurança operacional e a conformidade regulatória, assegurando que todas as atividades de manutenção sejam realizadas de acordo com os padrões estabelecidos.

Responsabilidades

  • Conhecimento em regulamentos aeronáuticos nacionais e internacionais.
  • Inglês técnico para leitura e interpretação de manuais.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em inspeção de helicópteros e/ou aeronaves de asa fixa.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas digitais de registro e controle de manutenção.
  • Capacidade de liderança e tomada de decisão em situações críticas.

Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para se juntar um time incrível, em franco crescimento, que mantem os mais altos padrões de qualidade, segurança e excelência nos serviços de transporte aéreo.

Oferecemos ótimas oportunidades de carreira, além de um pacote atrativo de remuneração e benefícios.

Na CHC, nos orgulhamos dos nossos valores e cultura:

Responsabilidade: Ter orgulho e responsabilidade por nossas ações e resultados.

Colaboração: Trabalhar em conjunto com transparência e confiança para promover a melhoria contínua.

Cuidado: Criar um ambiente seguro e sustentável para todos.

Integridade: Fazer o que é certo e promover uma cultura de respeito.

Excelência: Priorizar serviços de qualidade e estabelecer padrões da indústria.

Vem para a CHC!

title: Engenheiro(a) de Serviços - RJ
description:
Resumo do cargo:

Proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

1) Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sistemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);

2) Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas , diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;

3) Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;

4) Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;

5) Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);

6) Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);

7) Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);

8) Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, assim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;

9) Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.

Quem você é:

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
  • Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

description:

title: Partner Strategy & Management Manager
description:
At Keeta, we are building the future of food delivery in Brazil. As part of Meituan’s global ecosystem, our mission is clear: help people eat better and live better.


We are looking for a Partner Strategy & Ecosystem Manager to architect and scale our partner ecosystem. This is a strategic role responsible for designing commercial frameworks, performance systems, and lifecycle processes that enable partners to grow while strengthening platform performance.


About the Role


In this role, you will define how Keeta structures, incentivizes, manages, and scales Sales BPO. You will balance commercial objectives with partner enablement, ensuring sustainable growth across the marketplace.

You will act as the strategic bridge between partners and internal stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities


Partner Strategy & Process Framework

• Design comprehensive partner strategies, including commercial models and incentive structures

• Develop partnership economics that balance growth and profitability

• Optimize compensation and performance frameworks aligned with market dynamics


End to End Partner Lifecycle

• Build scalable onboarding, training, and enablement processes

• Define recruitment, evaluation, and transition standards

• Create structured frameworks for ongoing partner support


Performance Management & Execution

• Develop and implement partner performance evaluation systems

• Analyze performance results and drive improvement initiatives

• Translate strategic priorities into clear execution plans for partner managers


Settlement & Operational Excellence

• Execute partner settlement processes with accuracy and timeliness

• Identify opportunities to improve settlement efficiency and transparency

• Partner with Product to enhance systems and workflow automation


Requirements

• Experience in food delivery, e-commerce, marketplace, or on demand services

• Experience building scalable partner lifecycle processes

• Strong analytical skills with Excel, SQL, or BI tools

• Advanced English proficiency for cross border collaboration

• Availability to work on site in São Paulo


Why Join Keeta

• Shape the strategic foundation of Keeta’s partner ecosystem in Brazil

• High ownership and visibility from day one

• International exposure with global collaboration

title: Lead Engineer (JAVA)
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In:


As a JAVA Lead Engineer , you are a senior, hands-on engineer responsible for designing and delivering high-quality Java-based solutions in a transactional, distributed environment. You shape and execute technical direction in close collaboration with Architecture and Principal Engineers, ensuring the team’s implementation aligns with agreed standards, target architecture, and operational constraints.


The impact you will have:


Hands-on engineering & delivery (primary)

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs primarily in Java (and relevant frameworks) with strong engineering discipline.
  • Own complex technical work end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment readiness, and production validation.
  • Drive high-quality code practices: reviews, refactoring, performance tuning, and technical debt management.


Technical leadership in partnership

  • Collaborate with Architects and Principal Engineers to align on technical direction, reference architectures, and platform standards.
  • Translate architectural direction into executable team-level designs: service boundaries, integration patterns, transactional consistency, and data-access strategy.
  • Lead technical discovery/spikes and propose pragmatic options with trade-offs.


Transactional systems & data engineering

  • Design for correctness and integrity using transactional databases (SQL, schema evolution, indexing, query performance).
  • Handle concurrency, consistency models, idempotency, and failure modes (retries, sagas/outbox patterns where applicable).
  • Ensure safe migrations and backward-compatible changes to data structures and service contracts.


Mentorship & team enablement

  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, design sessions, and technical coaching.
  • Raise team capability in Java engineering practices, distributed systems thinking, and operational hygiene.


Quality, reliability, and operability (“build it, run it”)

  • Embed robust testing aligned to service criticality working closely with Quality Assurance Engineers.
  • Partner with Performance Engineers and IT Operations to ensure operational readiness: monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and production access patterns.
  • Participate in incident response as needed; work with the incident team on follow-ups (RCA actions, preventative fixes, resilience improvements).



What we’re looking for:


We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.


  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
  • Professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on backend/service work.
  • Strong Java expertise and common ecosystem frameworks (e.g., Spring / similar) and build/test tooling.
  • Strong SQL and transactional DB fundamentals (modeling, migrations, performance, locking/concurrency implications).
  • Distributed systems fundamentals: latency, resiliency patterns, observability, and debugging in production.
  • Strong testing discipline; familiarity with CI/CD best practices.
  • Demonstrable ownership of production systems in a transactional domain.
  • Advanced English.
  • Clear communication and alignment skills across Architecture, Principal Engineers, Product, QA, NOC, and IT Ops.


This role is Remote based in Brazil.



Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. By applying for a role at Sportingtech, you acknowledge and agree to the terms of our Candidates and Employees Privacy Policy. Please read this policy carefully to understand how we handle your personal data.

title: Senior API Engineer (NodeJS, TS, SDUI)
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role summary:

Lead the design and operation of APIs that power Server-Driven UI for Flutter clients while owning backend services across the stack. You’ll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.


Key responsibilities:

  • Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting.
  • Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks.
  • Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices.
  • Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality.
  • Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing).
  • Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards).
  • Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow.
  • Collaborate closely with mobile/web teams to define contracts and client compatibility.
  • Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.


Required skills & experience:

  • 7+ years building production microservices and APIs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.
  • Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems.
  • Hands-on development in TypeScript for backend services.
  • Proven RESTful API design and contract experience.
  • Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies.
  • Strong with AWS (API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents).
  • Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers).
  • Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification.
  • Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties.
  • Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.).
  • Good spoken English


Nice to have:

  • Terraform or other IaC for managing AWS resources.
  • Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts).
  • Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics.
  • Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos).
  • Background in personalization/experimentation systems.
  • Hands-on development in Python for backend services.


Hiring signals:

  • Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements.
  • Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns.
  • Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems.
  • Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development

Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.

  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.

title: Finance Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
  • Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
  • Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
  • Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
  • Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
  • Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.


Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
  • Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
  • Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

title: Editorial Graphic Designer (Interiors + Spaces)
description:
So… who the heck is Residence Supply?


I'm Jacky, the founder. We started as a local lighting brand obsessed with historical architecture and heirloom craftsmanship. In just a few years we blew past 8 figures, launched hundreds of handcrafted SKUs, and built a cult following of design-obsessed homeowners. Our fixtures live in Architectural Digest–worthy homes.


Now we're building the ULTIMATE creative team. One that takes us from \"fastest-growing DTC brand\" to category-defining design house. We need a graphic designer who doesn't just execute... but one who sees the world the way our customers do. Through the lens of beauty, heritage, and taste.


What You'll Do

  • Design editorial ads that feel like they were pulled from a print magazine
  • Translate interior design trends and RS products into visual stories that stop the scroll
  • Build mood boards and visual direction decks to guide campaigns
  • Maintain and elevate brand visual consistency across every creative touchpoint
  • Collaborate with our Creative Strategist, Content team, and Founder on campaign ideation

Who You Are

  • 3+ years designing for high-end lifestyle, interiors, fashion, or luxury DTC brands
  • Your portfolio looks like a coffee table book, not a social media dump
  • Obsessed with typography, white space, negative space, and editorial composition
  • You follow interior designers, architects, and design publications
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
  • You understand the difference between beautiful and effective
  • Architecture or interior design background? You're already shortlisted.


What We're Building

Residence Supply is not trying to be another ecommerce brand. We're becoming a heritage-driven design house growing 100% year over year. This role will define the visual language that new customers judge us by. Your work will live in catalogs, on Pinterest boards of people building their dream homes, and in the feeds of the most design-literate buyers in the country.


This is your chance to join a founding creative team before the rocket takes off.


What We're Offering

  • Competitive Salary
  • 10 days PTO per year
  • Opportunity to grow into creative strategist/lead graphic designer
  • Fully remote


How to Apply

Don't send us a generic application. Send us:

  • A portfolio or 3–5 pieces you're most proud of... especially anything editorial, catalog, or interiors-adjacent please!
  • A quick paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of a Residence Supply print catalog
  • Tell us: what brand's visual identity do you wish you had built and why?


If the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Good luck.

title: Over-the Counter (OTC) Sales Specialist
description:
Mackay Marine is a global marine electronics service company with more than 500 employees across 60 service depots in twenty-two (22) countries, including the America's, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Mackay offers competitive salaries plus overtime, and benefits such as health/dental insurance, holiday leave, meal and transportation vouchers are available as well.

Mackay is currently seeking a fulltime and experienced Marine Over the Counter (OTC) Specialist who is proficient in English, to work onsite at our Rio location. Individuals with the skills and qualifications outlined below are encouraged to apply.

OTC SPECIALIST JOB SUMMARY

The OTC Specialist is an onsite, non-managerial position which reports to the Managing Director for Brazil. The responsibilities of the OTC Specialist include but are not limited to communicating directly with our customers to answer questions concerning the availability, price, and use of merchandise as well as providing technical guidance, timely quotations, and comprehensive proposals. Will process over-the-counter transactions, special orders, phone-in and internet sales orders as well as inter-company transfers. Will support other team members, customers and company accounts with parts ordering and fulfillment to support our business.

Responsibilities will also include material handling and shipping/receiving of goods which includes physical lifting, handling of boxes, pallet jacks and may include activities on ladders, lifts, forklift, power tools, hand tools, carrying and moving of parts and equipment.

OTC SPECIALIST JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Acts as the point of contact for customer sales, service, and information requests to ensure that customer needs are fulfilled with speed and professionalism.
  • Assist in the research of basic technical issues on products and service. Collect symptoms of customer problems and facilitate repairs.
  • Assist with incoming sales prospects or customer calls when outside sales staff are out of the office.
  • Provide customer quotes, proposals, and will follow up in a timely manner.
  • Build the business by identifying revenue opportunities within the marine industry.
  • Assist with the shipping and receiving functions to help facilitate the trafficking and accountability for all materials received and delivered for customer orders, inventory, repairs, or for internal use.
  • Direct service requests the appropriate team member.
  • Maintain work area and stockroom in a clean and orderly fashion.
  • Read customer orders, work orders, shipping orders, or requisitions to determine items to be moved, gathered, or distributed and/or shipped using Mackay’s ERP system.


OTC SALES SPECIALIST SKILLS NEEDED:

  • Prior knowledge of Marine electronic equipment is a plus.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as product brochures, operating and maintenance instructions, procedure manuals, etc.
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percentage.
  • Attention to detail and ability to organize materials effectively and efficiently.
  • Excellent customer service, communication (both oral and written), organizational, planning, and prioritization skills.


OTC SALES SPECIALIST QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Two years of post-secondary education.
  • Electronics and/or marine background preferred.
  • Three years of inside or counter sales experience.
  • Good computer and Internet skills
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.


Applicants must be authorized to work in Brazil without sponsorship.  Successful completion of a thorough background check will be required upon acceptance of an employment offer.

description:
Estamos em busca de um/a Gerente de Obras Civis, que será responsável pela execução civil de projetos petroquímicos, controlando interfaces, assegurando conformidade técnica, integridade estrutural, execução sequenciada e aderência a requisitos de segurança de processo. Este/a profissional atuará em uma de nossas obras na região do Rio de Janeiro/RJ, tendo estas atribuições principais:


  • Alinhar bases civis, estruturas, pipe-racks, utilidades e áreas de processo conforme sequenciamento eletromecânico e de instrumentação do projeto;
  • Conduzir reuniões técnicas multidisciplinares (Civil, Mecânica, Tubulação, E&I, Automação, SMS) para garantir a compatibilização de projetos e a antecipação de interferências críticas durante a execução das obras;
  • Validar soluções de projeto civil com foco nas necessidades específicas da planta, como cargas dinâmicas de equipamentos rotativos, vibração, fundações especiais para tanques e suportação de tubulações;
  • Controlar interfaces com montagens industriais, garantindo que as estruturas civis, bases e alinhamentos estejam liberados dentro do prazo para instalação de equipamentos críticos;
  • Gerenciar o desenvolvimento e atualização do ‘’As Built” civil sincronizado com alterações de campo, revisões de engenharia e modificações industriais (MOCs);
  • Acompanhar e validar ensaios e controles tecnológicos essenciais para áreas industriais, como ensaio de compactação, ensaios de integridade estrutural, controle de concretagem para bases de equipamentos e pavimentos industriais;
  • Integrar a obra civil aos requisitos de segurança de processo, garantindo atendimento a normas, zoneamentos, distanciamentos, contenções, bacias e drenagem industrial;
  • Gerenciar a interface com fornecedores e contratados, alinhando soluções técnicas e cronogramas para minimizar impactos entre civil, montagem eletromecânica e comissionamento;
  • Atuar em parceria com a área de Suprimentos, dimensionando corretamente a compra de materiais, prezando por custo e boa gestão de estoques;
  • Manter relacionamento produtivo e transparente com entidades sindicais e órgãos fiscalizadores, conhecendo a legislação trabalhista e convenção coletiva, preservando a segurança empresarial.


Perfil Requerido:

  • Formação Superior completa em Engenharia Civil;
  • Pós-Graduação e/ou MBA em Gerenciamento de Projetos, Gestão da Construção Civil, Segurança de Processos Industriais ou Gestão de Riscos;
  • Sólida experiência em obras do ramo industrial (plantas químicas, petroquímicas, siderúrgicas ou de processamento de gás, refinarias, termelétricas ou demais correlatas);
  • Amplo conhecimento das modalidades de contratos e subcontratos e suas implicações no andamento do projeto;
  • Conhecimentos acerca de metodologias 3D voltadas à modelagem e integração multidisciplinar (Civil, Mecânica, Tubulação, E&I);
  • Conhecimentos acerca dos principais softwares do Pacote Office, sobretudo Excel;
  • Disponibilidade / mobilidade para atuar em regime 100% presencial na região do Rio de Janeiro/RJ.



Sobre a Odebrecht:


A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é uma empresa que presta serviços nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais, sediada no Brasil e atende além deste país, outros quatro mercados: Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. Composta por mais de 20 mil Integrantes, a Odebrecht gera oportunidades de trabalho para as populações locais e contribui para o desenvolvimento sustentável de cada região, atuando nas seguintes áreas:


✔ Transporte e Logística

✔ Energia

✔ Saneamento

✔ Engenharia Industrial

✔ Desenvolvimento Urbano e Edificações



Nossa Cultura:


A Nossa Cultura é um conjunto de princípios, conceitos e critérios, com foco na educação e no trabalho, que provê os fundamentos éticos, morais e conceituais para a atuação dos integrantes do Grupo. Valorizamos potencialidades do ser humano, como a disposição para servir, a capacidade e o desejo de evoluir e a vontade de superar resultados. Acreditamos, com convicção e determinação, que a prática da Cultura Odebrecht e das nossas políticas, com atuação ética, íntegra e transparente e o compromisso em promover a diversidade, nos fortalecem e aumentam a nossa competitividade, no rumo da sobrevivência, do crescimento e da perpetuidade.

title: Sales Manager
description:
About the Job

What if every conversation you have, every partnership you build, could accelerate the progress of life science research and precision medicine?

At GeneMind, we are dedicated to making life readable and health actionable through independent innovation in high-throughput gene sequencing technology. We break global technological barriers, deliver accessible and reliable genomic tools to laboratories, hospitals, and research institutions worldwide, and empower scientists and clinicians to turn data into discovery—and discovery into real-world impact.

Working at GeneMind means joining a mission-driven team that combines cutting-edge R&D, industrial execution, and global growth. You will not only sell products but also shape the future of the genomics industry. Supported by passionate innovators, strong technical platforms, and a fast-growing global market, you will grow faster, achieve more, and build a meaningful career in one of the most promising fields of our time.


Position Summary

Reporting to the Regional Sales Director, the Sales Specialist / Sales Manager will be the key commercial driver for GeneMind in assigned territories. You will build channel ecosystems, develop key accounts and KOL networks, drive market expansion, and deliver sustainable sales growth. This is a customer-centric, technical, and strategic sales role that combines channel management, key customer development, market insight, and cross-team collaboration—not just order execution. You will directly contribute to GeneMind’s global expansion and market leadership in next-generation sequencing (NGS).


Key Measures Of Success

  • Achievement of quarterly and annual sales targets, revenue, and order intake
  • Healthy channel partner development, activation, and retention
  • Successful development of key accounts and KOL relationship building
  • Accurate market intelligence collection and competitive strategy support
  • High customer satisfaction and long-term partnership loyalty
  • Effective product training and capability improvement for channel partners


Position Responsibilities

  • Develop and manage channel partners in assigned regions, expand market coverage, and build a stable, high-quality distribution system.
  • Identify and develop key customers and KOLs; establish long-term, trusted professional relationships.
  • Collect and analyze market dynamics, competitor activities, pricing, and customer needs to support regional sales strategies.
  • Deliver professional product presentations and online/offline training to channel partners to improve their sales and technical capabilities.
  • Support partners to close deals, including joint customer visits, demand analysis, solution design, and project follow-up.
  • Develop and execute quarterly and annual regional sales plans, ensure target delivery, and maintain healthy sales funnel management.
  • Collaborate with internal teams including technical support, marketing, and customer service to ensure smooth project delivery and excellent customer experience.
  • Represent GeneMind in academic and industry activities to enhance brand influence and market penetration.

The above responsibilities are representative but not exhaustive; duties may be adjusted to meet business needs.


Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Medicine, Molecular Biology, Biomedical Engineering, or related fields ; Master’s degree is a strong plus.
  • Minimum 3 years of working experience in the NGS / sequencing industry .
  • Demonstrated experience in sales, channel development, or key account management in life science instruments, IVD, or sequencing-related fields.
  • Experience selling sequencing instruments or related laboratory equipment is highly preferred.
  • Professional, self-motivated, and target-oriented with strong learning and communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to build trust with partners, KOLs, and research clients.
  • Ability and willingness to travel frequently as needed.
  • High integrity, customer-first mindset, and alignment with GeneMind’s mission and values.


Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets in the life science or IVD industry.
  • Existing channel resources, customer network, or KOL connections in regional markets.
  • Experience in technical sales or solution-based sales (not just transactional).
  • Strong presentation, training, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Familiarity with NGS workflows, clinical diagnostics, or life science research scenarios.
  • Global market exposure or cross-cultural communication experience is a plus.


Who We Are

GeneMind is a leading global innovator and manufacturer of gene sequencing systems with independent core intellectual property. We develop and produce high-performance sequencing platforms to support scientific research and precision medicine across the globe. We embrace diversity, encourage growth, and empower every team member to create real impact.

We are an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Java Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas. .
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um/uma Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Java Sênior para fazer parte do nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por implementar e orquestrar microsserviços modernos, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (Kafka/RabbitMQ) assumindo entregas de ponta a ponta, da implementação ao deploy em produção. Esperamos que você encabece integrações complexas, atue no tuning avançado das aplicações e suas integrações com bancos de dados (SQL/NoSQL) e seja protagonista na adoção de tecnologias emergentes, além de criar ambientes de confiança para revisões de código de alto padrão.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Implementar e evoluir arquiteturas de aplicações de microsserviços e sistemas orientados a eventos, garantindo escalabilidade, resiliência e manutenibilidade ao longo do tempo;
  • Elaborar templates de arquitetura de aplicação de referência para o time, sempre que demandado;
  • Protagonizar decisões técnicas com visão de impacto, explicitando trade-offs para o time e para produto, mesmo em cenários com informações incompletas;
  • Garantir a estabilidade dos sistemas em produção, realizando a resposta a incidentes, definindo prioridades de correção e propondo melhorias estruturais para evitar recorrência;
  • Implementar e disseminar práticas de observabilidade (OpenTelemetry, APM com Datadog/NewRelic/Dynatrace) e tracing distribuído para aumentar a previsibilidade operacional;
  • Conduzir code reviews de alto padrão, orientando o time em boas práticas de arquitetura, design patterns, testes e segurança;
  • Atuar em integrações complexas com sistemas internos e externos, aplicando padrões de resiliência como Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA;
  • Identificar gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria em queries SQL, estratégias de cache e configurações de pool de conexões para otimizar a performance das aplicações;
  • Apoiar diretamente líderes técnicos (Tech Leads) em acordos técnicos entre squad, produto e demais áreas, traduzindo complexidade técnica em impacto de negócio de forma clara e rastreável;
  • Explorar e adotar tecnologias emergentes de forma responsável, avaliando custo, benefício e risco antes da incorporação no stack do time.
  • Aprimorar continuamente os processos e práticas de desenvolvimento, aplicando técnicas de uso de Inteligência Artificial para otimizar o desenvolvimento de software, de forma avançada e responsável.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:


  • Profundidade em Java avançado: Multithread, gerenciamento de memória/GC, Virtual Threads (Java 21) e domínio das diferenças entre versões LTS, bem como domínio total de programação funcional;
  • Domínio amplo de Design Patterns com capacidade de reconhecer o momento certo de aplicá-los; entendimento de como a Injeção de Dependência funciona internamente (Reflection/Proxies);
  • Experiência sólida com Spring (Boot, Data, Security) e uso de frameworks reativos;
  • Domínio de estratégias de resiliência em integrações: Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA (ex: Resilience4j); domínio do conceito de Idempotência;
  • Experiência prática e profunda com Kafka (Partições, Offsets, Consumer Groups) e RabbitMQ avançado (DLQ, Retry Policies, Exchanges);
  • Capacidade de realizar tuning de queries SQL, criação de índices, e estratégias de cache (local vs distribuído, TTL e invalidação);
  • Domínio avançado de pelo menos um banco de dados relacional e um banco NoSQL (MongoDB ou DynamoDB);
  • Domínio de observabilidade avançada com OpenTelemetry, pelo menos uma ferramenta de APM (Datadog/NewRelic/Dynatrace) e tracing distribuído;
  • Experiência prática com Kubernetes. Não irá administrar diretamente, mas é necessária experiência de interpretação do ecossistema;
  • Experiência prática com componentes de pelo menos uma Cloud (AWS ou GCP)
  • Capacidade real e experiência em Documentação como código usando Mermaid ou PlantUML através de arquivos markdown;
  • Domínio sólido de estratégias em pelo menos uma ferramenta de IA assistida (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity ou Claude Code), bem como experiência prática de consumo de pelo menos 1 tipo de MCP Server através destas ferramentas.


Você irá se destacar se:


  • Ser committer ativo em repositórios open-source relevantes;
  • Experiência em tuning avançado de integração com bancos de dados usando JPA e pool de conexões (ex: HikariCP);
  • Ter realizado publicações técnicas em canais relevantes (blog, artigos, palestras, conferências);
  • Experiência com frameworks como Apache Camel ou outros de integração de sistemas (ESB/EDA);
  • Experiência em arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA) de alta complexidade;
  • Conhecimento ou experiência com bancos de dados colunares ou baseados em grafos;
  • Certificações Cloud (AWS ou GCP) ativas;
  • Implementação de API Gateways (Kong, Sensedia, AWS API Gateway) via configuração e/ou código;
  • Experiência em integração arquitetural de APIs de LLM (LangChain, RAG/bancos vetoriais) ou criação de soluções próprias baseadas em IA;
  • Capacidade de liderar migrações de monolitos para microsserviços;
  • Ter implementado mais de dois exemplos de servidores MCP de alta complexidade técnica.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;

  • Seguro de vida.

Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!


MoveUp Media

title: Dental Insurance Posting Agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.


As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you’ll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You’ll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.


About iCore


iCore is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.

We are more than a software company. iCoreConnect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.

Behind iCoreConnect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We’re proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.


Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.


Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.


Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.


Objectives:


  • Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
  • Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
  • Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
  • Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
  • Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
  • Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
  • Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
  • Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
  • Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns


Competencies:

  • Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
  • Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
  • High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
  • Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
  • Full English proficiency
  • Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
  • Ability to pass job-specific assessments


Benefits:


Personal:

  • Be a valued leader, not just a trainer

You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.


  • Make a real difference at scale

Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices , and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.


  • Work with a mission-driven team

You’ll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.


  • 100% remote – work from home

Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.


  • Better work-life balance

While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.


  • Stability and long-term growth

Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.


Professional:

  • Grow your training and leadership skills

Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.


  • Work with industry leaders in dental

Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.


  • Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology

Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.


  • Build and lead teams

Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.


  • Expand your industry network

Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.


  • Develop enterprise-level experience

Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.


What you can expect from a career with our team!

  • Competitive hourly rate
  • Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST
  • Commitment: Full-time, 40+ hours per week
  • Work Setup: Fully remote position


You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals.

If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!

title: Vaga para Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior (PJ) – Topshare
description:
ATENÇÃO: REQUISITO OBRIGATÓRIO


APENAS CANDIDATOS COM EXPERIÊNCIA SÓLIDA E COMPROVADA EM NODE.JS DEVEM SE CANDIDATAR.


CANDIDATURAS SEM ESTES REQUISITOS SERÃO DESCONSIDERADAS.


SOBRE A TOPSHARE E O ECOSSISTEMA CREATONOMY


A Topshare é uma plataforma de tecnologia que atua no coração da creator economy, sendo parte do grupo Creatonomy. Buscamos um profissional para atuar na arquitetura, desenvolvimento, manutenção e aprimoramento da plataforma Topshare, além de participar ativamente na criação da plataforma Creatonomy e em outros projetos estratégicos do grupo. O foco é em soluções escaláveis e de alta performance para todo o ecossistema.


Operamos em um ambiente de trabalho totalmente remoto, valorizando a flexibilidade, a inovação e a excelência técnica.


MISSÃO DO CARGO


Atuar como referência técnica em arquitetura backend, liderando a concepção e a implementação de soluções robustas, escaláveis e de alta performance. O profissional será responsável por garantir a robustez, a escalabilidade e a alta disponibilidade dos sistemas, traduzindo requisitos de negócio em arquiteturas sólidas e eficientes, com foco na stack Node.js (Backend).


RESPONSABILIDADES E ESCOPO DE ATIVIDADES


1. DESENVOLVIMENTO DE BACKEND E ARQUITETURA

Projetar, desenvolver e manter APIs e microsserviços robustos e escaláveis, utilizando a stack Node.js com NestJS (framework obrigatório), para a Topshare e para a plataforma Creatonomy. Isso inclui a modelagem, gestão e otimização de dados em bancos Neo4j (obrigatório) e MongoDB (desejável), garantindo a integridade e a alta disponibilidade do sistema. O profissional deverá contribuir ativamente para a definição da arquitetura de microsserviços e a evolução contínua da stack tecnológica. Será obrigatório o uso de Docker para empacotamento e execução dos serviços em ambientes isolados.


2. DEFINIÇÃO DE PADRÕES E ARQUITETURA

Estabelecer padrões de desenvolvimento, arquitetura de software e boas práticas para o backend. Será responsável por revisar e validar decisões arquiteturais, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e manutenibilidade dos sistemas. Deverá propor e implementar melhorias contínuas na infraestrutura e processos de CI/CD.


3. QUALIDADE DE CÓDIGO E TESTES

Utilizar Git e seguir rigorosamente as boas práticas de Git Flow, realizando pull requests e code reviews de forma contínua para assegurar a qualidade do código. Será responsável por implementar testes unitários com Jest, testes de integração e testes de carga para garantir a resiliência do sistema. Além disso, deverá atuar como referência técnica, compartilhando conhecimento e propondo melhorias na arquitetura e nos processos de CI/CD.


4. DISPONIBILIDADE PARA INCIDENTES CRÍTICOS

O Contratado se compromete a responder e atuar na correção de erros, bugs ou falhas críticas de produção em tempo hábil, fora do horário comercial, quando a indisponibilidade do sistema impactar diretamente a operação ou a receita da Contratante. Esta atuação é inerente à natureza do serviço de alta disponibilidade e não configura controle de jornada.


REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS


• Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Backend, com foco em sistemas distribuídos e escaláveis

• Proficiência em Node.js

• Experiência OBRIGATÓRIA com NestJS (framework Node.js para desenvolvimento de aplicações escaláveis)

• Experiência OBRIGATÓRIA com testes unitários utilizando Jest

• Experiência OBRIGATÓRIA com Neo4j (Banco de Dados Orientado a Grafos)

• Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços e padrões de design

• Experiência sólida com Docker e conceitos de conteinerização

• Conhecimento e aplicação de boas práticas de versionamento com Git

• Experiência em design e otimização de APIs RESTful e/ou GraphQL


INFORMAÇÕES DA VAGA


Regime de Contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)

Remuneração: R$ 12.000,00/mês

Local: Remoto

Horário de Trabalho: De segunda a sexta-feira, em horário comercial


Se você é um(a) Arquiteto Backend Sênior que busca um desafio de ponta a ponta em um ecossistema de alta performance, candidate-se!

title: Senior Network Security Engineer
description:
The Network Security Engineer is responsible for protecting an organization’s networks and data from cyber threats. This role involves designing, implementing, and maintaining security infrastructure (firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, VPNs, etc.) and monitoring the network for vulnerabilities or incidents. The engineer will play a critical role in upholding Zero Trust security principles and ensuring high availability and integrity of network services in a dynamic, cloud-enabled environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Security Infrastructure Management: Configure, deploy, and maintain network security systems (firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN gateways, encryption devices) to safeguard internal networks and cloud environments.
  • Threat Monitoring & Incident Response: Monitor network traffic and logs for suspicious activities; promptly investigate and respond to security incidents or breaches to minimize impact.
  • Vulnerability Assessment: Conduct regular security audits, vulnerability scans, and penetration tests to identify and remediate network weaknesses. Implement patches and updates to address vulnerabilities and ensure systems are protected against emerging threats.
  • Access Control & Policies: Enforce access controls and network segmentation (supporting a Zero Trust Network Access model) by administering firewalls and network access control lists. Develop and update network security policies, standards, and procedures to align with best practices and compliance requirements.
  • Collaboration & Advisory: Work closely with IT infrastructure teams, application developers, and security architects to integrate security measures into new projects and systems. Provide guidance on secure network design and educate team members on security best practices.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain detailed documentation of configurations, incidents, and changes. Ensure all network security measures comply with relevant regulations and industry standards (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS) and assist in preparing for security audits.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • Technical Skills: Strong understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, etc.) and hands-on experience with network security technologies (firewalls such as Palo Alto/Cisco/Fortinet, IDS/IPS, VPN solutions, SIEM tools). Proficiency in configuring and managing firewalls and routing/switching equipment in complex networks.
  • Security Expertise: Knowledge of cybersecurity principles , threat landscape, and best practices (e.g., Zero Trust architecture, defense-in-depth, encryption, secure network design ). Ability to perform log analysis, intrusion detection, malware analysis basics, and incident handling.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for diagnosing network and security issues. Ability to respond effectively under pressure during security incidents or outages.
  • Communication & Teamwork: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders, and provide user training or guidance on security policies when needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced/Cloud Security: Experience with cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP networking and security services) or secure network design in hybrid cloud environments . Familiarity with SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) frameworks or software-defined networking is a plus.
  • Automation & Scripting: Scripting or automation skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to automate network/security tasks and improve efficiency in security operations.
  • Advanced Education: Master’s degree in Cybersecurity or Information Systems.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in network security, cybersecurity engineering, or a related IT infrastructure security role. Proven track record implementing and managing firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, and performing security monitoring and incident response in an enterprise or managed services environment.

Certifications:

  • Industry Certifications: Professional certifications are highly advantageous . Preferred certifications include CISSP, CISM (for security management knowledge) or CEH, GIAC (for technical security skills). Vendor-specific certifications such as Palo Alto Networks PCNSE/PCNSA are also valuable and demonstrate expertise in relevant technologies.

title: Technical Team Lead – Windows Network Services
description:
Technical Team Lead – Windows Network Services

12month contract + Extensions

Brazil

$37/hr - $46/hr

**Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

**Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.



The Technical Team Lead – Windows Network Services is responsible for the day-to-day operation of Active Directory and related network identity services in their scope. This includes managing domain controllers, implementing Group Policy changes, ensuring DNS/DHCP are running smoothly, and responding to any incidents affecting authentication or network directory services. They implement the Architect’s designs and standards on the ground, making configuration changes and overseeing maintenance. Additionally, they support integrations (e.g., if a new application needs AD integration or certificates) and handle routine upgrades and patches for AD and its companion services.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate and Monitor AD Environments: Oversee the health of AD domains and domain controllers in the region. This includes monitoring replication, FSMO roles, AD logs, and ensuring backups and disaster recovery procedures for AD are in place.
  • Implement GPO Changes: Create or update Group Policy Objects as needed, following the architectural guidelines. Test GPO changes and roll them out, managing GPO conflicts or inheritance issues. Delegate GPO management appropriately.
  • Certificate and Naming Services: Manage the day-to-day of AD Certificate Services (issuing/revoking certificates, root CA maintenance) and core networking services like DNS, DHCP, and NTP servers. Ensure DNS zones are correct and replicated, DHCP scopes are managed, and time synchronization is consistent.
  • Security Control Implementation: Apply and uphold security controls as defined by the Architect. For example, enforce the use of privileged access workstations or other controls for AD admins, ensure service accounts are being used properly, and implement changes from any AD security assessments (such as patching LDAP signing issues, etc.)..
  • Incident Response: Act as the escalation point for any incidents involving AD or WNS services. Lead troubleshooting for outages or cyber incidents (like a suspected AD compromise). Coordinate with Security Operations if needed to contain and remediate issues.
  • Support Integrations: Work with other IT teams to integrate systems with AD (for authentication/SSO) or to set up new trust relationships. Assist in configuration of SSO, MFA, or PAM solutions as they interface with AD.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify areas to improve performance or stability of AD and WNS (e.g., decommissioning legacy domain controllers, fine-tuning DNS configurations, optimizing login scripts or group policy processing). Implement improvements and document changes.


Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or similar (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in Windows Server administration and Active Directory management. Familiarity with global AD deployments is a plus.
  • Strong experience with core network services on Windows (DNS, DHCP, DFS, Certificate Services). Able to configure and troubleshoot these services expertly.
  • Experience in an enterprise IT operations or infrastructure team, with responsibilities including change management and incident management for critical services.
  • Knowledge of identity integrations (how AD works with Azure AD/Azure AD Connect, SSO protocols like SAML/Kerberos, etc.), and experience implementing MFA or PAM in conjunction with AD is beneficial.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.

This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.

We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.



Why this role exists

We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing DevOps operations and architecture support.

We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.

Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.



TL;DR

You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:

  • Lead cloud migrations to OCI
  • Design cloud architectures
  • Automate migrations and infrastructure
  • Coordinate DevOps engineers
  • Talk directly to clients
  • Help build repeatable DevOps processes

You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.

English is a plus, not required.



This is not a ticket-based DevOps job

If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.

This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:


\"We can automate 80% of this.\"

And then actually build the automation.



What you'll actually do

Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.



Cloud Migrations

A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.

Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.



Automation

We want to automate everything that can be automated:

  • Automated infrastructure provisioning
  • Migration scripts
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Environment replication
  • Monitoring setups

If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.



Client Discussions

You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.



Leading DevOps Engineers

As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.



What we're looking for

You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.

You likely:

  • Love automating infrastructure
  • Hate manual processes
  • Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
  • Are comfortable debugging production environments
  • Enjoy designing architectures
  • Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients

You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.



Technical Expectations

Cloud

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
  • AWS
  • Azure
  • GCP

    • DevOps

    • Docker
    • Kubernetes
    • Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
    • CI/CD pipelines
    • Linux systems administration
    • Networking fundamentals

    Automation

    Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.


    Languages

    Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.


    Why work with Quave

    We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.

    Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.

    Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).


    Pay and Benefits

    This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.

    • Fully remote work
    • Flexible hours
    • 22 days paid time off per year
    • Quarterly bonus based on company performance
    • AI allowance for productivity tools

    We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.


    Hiring Process

    • Application review
    • Technical conversation
    • Architecture discussion
    • Conversation(s) with one or more partners
    • This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the DevOps work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

title: ML/AI Engineer
description:
• Remote in LATAM
